item.description:
• Blocking, app limits and the daily cap now also stop downloads that were already running.
  • SaveMode always keeps the parts of macOS that keep you online working: DNS, Wi-Fi sign-in pages and security checks.
  • The daily cap starts fresh each day, even after a restart, and if SaveMode quits unexpectedly the pause lifts by itself.
  • "Only on metered networks" now counts only data used on hotspot and Low Data Mode networks.
  • macOS services and command-line tools now show clear names and icons.
  • The app list stays in place under your pointer.
  • "Open SaveMode" brings the window to the front.
  • A clearer welcome tour walks you through setup.
  • The Toggle shortcut and the AppleScript "usage" command work more reliably.

• Block only the apps that eat your data, and keep everything else online
  • Watch live per-app usage and bandwidth from the menu bar
  • Turn SaveMode on automatically when you join a hotspot
  • Set data limits, profiles and schedules for travel and work
  • Automate with Shortcuts and AppleScript
  • Get new versions automatically with built-in updates
  • Unlock Pro with a lifetime license key from Gumroad
